grf.generated_reality: A single ClayVM should own both operand and activation stacks explicitly, receive provenance-bound canonical ClayCode lowering, and use PR602-style source-level differential tests as an oracle rather than retain a second runtime.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: A VM with an explicit operand stack but Python-recursive CALL control is only host-stack-independent for shallow programs; the host recursion boundary can fail before the advertised ClayVM call-depth or step budget.
grf.primary_source_support: Current Python sys documentation states that the interpreter recursion limit protects against C-stack overflow and warns that setting it too high can crash the process; therefore raising host recursion is not an acceptable ClayVM ownership mechanism.
grf.discriminator: Replace recursive VM CALL control with an iterative explicit frame stack and run ordinary deterministic deep finite-call regression plus existing differential/fail-closed gates; no new unusual experiment is required.
